study_note: Three-seed, 14-million-decision Humanoid Walk policy-initialized MPPI ablation against the official-style TD-MPC2 state baseline. At every real decision, effective planning iteration 0 contains 512 stochastic policy-prior trajectories and no Gaussian proposals. Its 64 elite trajectories fit TD-MPC2's usual time-indexed diagonal Gaussian; effective iterations 1-7 each draw all 512 proposals from that successively refined Gaussian and contain no policy-prior trajectories. All model, optimizer, replay, loss, training, evaluation, population, elite, horizon, temperature, standard-deviation, and configured-iteration settings match configs/dmcontrol/algs/tdmpc2_humanoid_walk_state.json. Distinct W&B metadata identifies this new, unreported planning intervention.
